description: Celery (Python task queue): purges, worker control, workers and task calls (project code), and read commands.

rules.note: `purge` deletes every waiting task from the queues.
`control` changes running workers: it stops them, revokes tasks, or changes limits and queues. `amqp` administers the message broker.

safe.note: `inspect` of worker state (ping, active, scheduled, reserved, revoked, and registered tasks, statistics, and queues) and `status` only ask the workers. They import the app of the project to connect, and they do not run tasks. `inspect conf` and `report` print settings, so they are not here (dev round 3).

project_commands.note: `worker`, `beat`, `multi`, `call`, and `shell` run tasks or code of the project.
